messages:
maria: Quick check — we have a vendor bump for libgrpc that landed in main (PR #3421). Cutoff is 09:00 PST tomorrow. Who can own cherry-picking this to release-candidate and updating the lockfile?

alex: I can do the cherry-pick, but need someone to run a quick smoke on dedicated. cc @jen for lockfile update. :eyes:

jen: I can take the lockfile (go.sum + yarn.lock). Will run `pnpm install` and `go mod tidy` then push. Any special vendor submodule steps?

sam: vendor is a submodule under `third_party/vendor/grpc` — after the cherry-pick you'll need to `git submodule update --init --recursive` on the RC branch. Also check `tools/packager` build flags changed in the PR.

chris: Heads-up: this bump touches runtime kernel selection code path — recommend a canary rollout to dedicated pool before full release. I can flip the canary if we schedule. :white_check_mark:

maria: Plan: alex cherry-picks into `release-candidate` now, jen updates lockfiles and posts the new commit, sam runs submodule update and quick build, chris does canary tests. If all green we cut. Sounds good?

alex: Starting now. I'll push cherry-pick to `release-candidate` as `cherry/grpc-bump-3421` and open PR linking original. Command I run: ```bash
git fetch origin main
git checkout -b cherry/grpc-bump-3421 release-candidate
git cherry-pick -x <commit-hash-from-3421>
# resolve conflicts if any
git push origin cherry/grpc-bump-3421
```

jen: After alex pushes I'll: 1) checkout branch, 2) run `go mod tidy` and `pnpm install`, 3) update `pnpm-lock.yaml` and `go.sum`, 4) push as `chore/lockfile/grpc-3421`. Will also add a changelog note: "grpc: bump to v1.12.3 (security/fix) — PR #3421"

sam: When both PRs are up, I'll: `git submodule sync`, `git submodule update --init third_party/vendor/grpc`, then run `./scripts/build --targets=runtime` and smoke test `./scripts/integrations/local_test.sh`. If anything fails I'll post logs.

release-bot: New release checklist item created: DEP-3421 (owner: alex) — pinged @jen @sam @chris — cutoff: 09:00 PST 1876629600.

maria: Thanks release-bot. Quick reminder: update the release notes page with the changelog line and mark the PR as release-critical if it affects runtime path.

alex: Cherry-pick pushed, PR open: https://git.company/repo/pull/4589 (title: cherry: grpc bump 3421 -> release-candidate). No conflicts. :shipit:

jen: Lockfile PR open: https://git.company/repo/pull/4590 — updated `go.sum` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`. I ran `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` locally and `go test ./...` — all green. Added changelog entry in `docs/release-notes/unreleased.md`.

sam: Submodule updated and local build passed. Ran `./scripts/integrations/local_test.sh` — one flaky test `integration/disk_io_test` failed once; re-ran and passed. Logs: `CI logs -> /tmp/ci-dep-3421.log`.

chris: Canaries scheduled on dedicated pool `dedicated-small` for 30m starting in 20m. I'll monitor latency and error rate. If anything spikes we rollback the canary and revert cherry PR.

maria: Great. If canary and CI stay green let's merge both PRs and mark DEP-3421 as done. I'll be on-call tomorrow morning for cutoff. Thanks team! :tada:
